# UchiSamBot

> UchiSamBot (Study Helper) is a Telegram bot that helps school students understand their homework: it breaks every task down step by step, explains the topic in simple words, checks the student's own solution, and makes revision notes and flashcards. It works in Russian and English, right inside Telegram, with no app to install.

UchiSamBot is built for school students and their parents. The first 5 breakdowns are free; after that, breakdowns are paid with Telegram Stars: 30 Stars for a single breakdown, 120 Stars for a pack of 5, 300 Stars for a pack of 15. No sign-up and no personal details are required in the bot. All AI processing runs on the team's own infrastructure in the European Union; task content is not sent to third-party AI services.

Open the bot: https://t.me/UchiSamBot
